blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions.
  This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.
blocks.zh:
神经病假说认为,预先训练的语言模型位于任务特定专家在重量空间的密集街区,随机的高斯人扰动可以发现. 我们重复所报告的进展,但表明它们不需要这种几何解释。 扰动单个解码器块已经恢复了大部分改进,同时保持了模型完全被冷冻并在其输出对数中添加了随机偏差相匹配或超过大多数推理任务的全重扰动. 这表明基于产出多样性、基于验证的选择和表决的另一种解释。 我们将此观点正式化为"Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV)"(Persturb-Select-Vote (PSV)),这是一种一般程序,它产生被扰动的预测器,在小型验证组上选择高性能的成员,并汇总他们的预测.
这种解释将神经发作与既定的推论时间方法相连接,包括采样,自相容性,以及验证器-导取. 一阶分析进一步表明,小重量扰动主要通过它们诱发的对数变化来作用. 我们把这一分析扩大到远景,在目测PSV中,在包括地球观测在内的域位转移下,其性能大有改进,而全重扰动则几乎没有带来额外好处。 这些结果加在一起表明,通过产出多样性、选择和表决,可以取得由附近加权空间专家获得的收益。 Logit PSV以完全被冻结的模式实现这些好处,提供了一种简单、无培训的替代语言和视觉全重扰动综艺。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Gan & Isola (2026) reported a striking phenomenon: randomly perturbing the weights of a pretrained language model can produce many variants that outperform it on specific reasoning tasks. The empirical gains are substantial, reaching up to 52.8 52.8 accuracy points (Countdown with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, from 10.8 % 10.8\% to 63.6 % 63.6\% ), and require little compute compared to fine-tuning. The authors propose a geometric explanation: pretrained weights of sufficiently large models are surrounded by a dense thicket of task-specialized models, recoverable by blind Gaussian perturbations.
blocks.zh: Gan & Isola (2026年) 报告了一个惊人的现象:随机扰动一个预先训练的语言模型的权重,可以产生许多变体,在具体推理任务上表现优于它. 经验性收益很大,达到52.8.52.8的精度点(与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct进行对比,从10.8% 10.8\%到63.6% 63.6\%),与微调相比不需要计算。 作者提出几何解释: 足够大的模型的预先训练的重量被密集的厚厚的任务专用模型包围,由盲目的高斯扰动可以回收.

blocks.en: This paper first asks whether the gain requires perturbing the entire network. It does not: perturbing only a small fraction of the model, or even a single decoder block, recovers much of the gain. Pushing this observation to its limit, weight perturbations can be removed altogether: the model is kept completely frozen and only its output is perturbed: each member differs by a random Gaussian bias, fixed throughout autoregressive generation, added to the logits before greedy decoding. This logit-only variant performs no additional computation inside the network and modifies no model weight. Nevertheless, it recovers, and in some settings improves on, the gains of full-weight perturbations. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, it raises MATH-500 accuracy from 63.3 % 63.3\% to 81.3 % 81.3\% , compared with 74.7 % 74.7\% for the full-weight perturbation ensemble.
blocks.zh: 本文首先询问收益是否需要扰整个网络. 它没有: 扰动只有模型的一小部分,甚至一个单一的解码器块,可以回收大部分的收益. 将这种观察推到其极限,重量扰动可以完全去除: 模型被完全冻结,只有它的输出被扰动:每个成员通过随机的高斯偏差而不同,在整个自旋生成过程中固定,在贪婪解码之前加入对数. 此只登录的变体在网络内部不执行额外的计算,也不修改模型重量. 尽管如此,它还是恢复了全重扰动的收益,并在一些环境下有所改进。 在OLMo-3-7B-指令上,它将MATH-500的精度从63.3% 63.3\%提高到81.3%,而全重扰动综艺的精度为74.7% 74.7\%.

blocks.en:
The Neural Thickets interpretation attributes these gains to local experts in weight space. Our experiments suggest a simpler account: perturbations induce output diversity, validation-based selection retains useful members, and voting aggregates their predictions. Neural Thickets can therefore be viewed as an instance of a broader perturb-select-vote (PSV) template: sample random perturbations, score the resulting members on a small validation set, retain the top K K , and vote at test time.
This output-space view connects PSV to standard inference-time methods. A logit bias modifies the relative probability of each token, and greedy decoding under random biases defines a perturb-and-MAP sampler ( Papandreou & Yuille, 2011 ) . Selecting members by validation performance retains the biases that perform best on the target task, analogously to best-of- N N and verifier-guided selection ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , while voting relates PSV to self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . A first-order analysis further supports this view: small weight perturbations act, to leading order, through the logit shifts they induce. This paper then isolates the roles of sampling, selection, and voting: on strong base models, temperature-tuned sampling with majority voting already matches full-weight PSV, showing that output diversity and ensembling explain most of the gain. On weaker models, validation-based selection remains important as it filters unreliable members before aggregation.
blocks.zh:
神经细胞解释将这些收益归结于体重空间的本地专家. 我们的实验建议了一个更简单的说明:扰动会诱导产出的多样性,基于验证的选择会保留有用的成员,投票会汇总他们的预测. 因此,神经切除器可以看作是一个更广泛的扰动-选择投票(PSV)模板的例子:随机扰动样本,在小型验证集上给产生的成员评分,保留顶级K K,在测试时投票.
这种输出-空间视图将PSV与标准推论-时间方法连接起来. 一个对数偏差会改变每个令牌的相对概率,在随机偏差下贪婪的解码定义了一个扰动和-MAP采样器(Papandreou & Yuille, 2011). 通过验证性能选择成员,保留了在目标任务上表现最佳的偏差,类似于最佳N和核查者指导性选择(Cobbe等人,2021年),而表决则将PSV与自我一致性联系起来(Wang等人,2023年)。 一阶分析进一步支持这一观点:小重量的扰动行为,通过它们诱导的对数转动,引导秩序. 本文然后将采样,选择和投票的作用隔离:在强基模型上,经过温度调整且多数投票的采样已经与全重的PSV匹配,表明产出多样性和综艺能解释大部分收益. 在较弱的模型中,基于验证的选择仍然很重要,因为它在汇总之前过滤不可靠的成员。

blocks.en: Finally, the analysis extends to pretrained vision models under domain shift. In this setting, the analogue of a task expert is a domain expert: a perturbed representation that improves linear-probe performance on a target domain. Full-weight PSV, which perturbs the vision backbone and fits one probe per member, is compared to logit-only PSV, which fits a single probe and perturbs only the resulting class logits. The results support the same conclusion as in language: perturbing the logits is sufficient to recover the gains of full-weight perturbations, and often improves out-of-domain performance while leaving the backbone unchanged.
blocks.zh: 最后,分析扩大到域转移下预先训练好的愿景模型。 在此设定中,任务专家的模拟是一个域专家:一种扰动的表达,可以改善目标域的线性探测性能. 完全重量的PSV对视网膜骨干进行扰动,并适合每个成员一个探测器,它被比作只登录的PSV,它只适合一个探测器,并且只扰动所产生的类记录. 结果支持与语言相同的结论:扰动对数足以恢复全重扰动的增益,并经常提高域外性能,同时保持主干不变.

blocks.en: Our results do not rule out useful structure in the neighborhood of pretrained weights. They show, however, that such structure is not required to obtain the observed gains. PSV is better understood as output diversification, validation-based filtering, and ensembling. Beyond its role in interpreting Neural Thickets, PSV yields a simple, training-free output-space procedure that substantially improves performance on specialized tasks and domains.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果并不排除在预先受过训练的重量附近建立有用的结构。 然而,它们表明,不需要这种结构来取得观察到的收益。 PSV被更好的理解为输出多样化,基于验证的过滤,以及综艺. PSV除了在诠释神经色素的作用外,还生成一个简单,无培训的输出-空间程序,大大改进了在专门任务和领域的性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Test-time sampling, selection, and voting. Inference-time scaling improves fixed models by generating multiple candidates and aggregating or selecting them. Self-consistency votes over sampled reasoning paths ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , while best-of- N N selects candidates using a verifier or reward model ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) ; more generally, increasing inference-time compute can substantially improve performance ( Snell et al., 2025 ) . Perturb-and-MAP provides a classical connection between perturbation and sampling, where random logit perturbations followed by MAP inference induce samples from a target distribution ( Papandreou & Yuille, 2011 ; Maddison et al., 2017 ) . Neural Thickets ( Gan & Isola, 2026 ) combines these ingredients: perturbations of the weights generate candidate models, validation performance selects them, and voting aggregates their predictions.
blocks.zh: 测试时间采样、选择和表决。 推论时间的缩放通过生成多个候选人并汇总或选择他们来改进固定模式. 相对于抽样推理路径的自我一致投票(王等人,2023年),而最佳N选手则使用验证或奖励模式选择候选人(Cobbe等人,2021年);更一般地说,越来越多的推论时间计算可以大大改善绩效(Snell等人,2025年). Perturb-and-MAP提供了扰动和采样之间的经典联系,其中随机对数扰动之后的MAP推断诱导来自目标分布的样本(Papandreou & Yuille, 2011; Maddison等人,2017年). 神经纹理(Gan & Isola, 2026)结合了这些成分: 扰动重量产生候选模型,验证性能选择它们,投票汇总它们的预测.

blocks.en: Logit-space control. Many methods alter the behavior of a frozen model directly through its logits, including classifier-free guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ) , contrastive decoding ( Li et al., 2023 ) , post-hoc calibration ( Guo et al., 2017 ) , and watermarking, which biases a pseudo-random subset of token logits to embed a detectable signal ( Kirchenbauer et al., 2023 ) . These methods design or fit a particular logit transformation for a desired behavior. In contrast, logit PSV uses task-agnostic random biases and relies on selection and voting to exploit the resulting output diversity.
blocks.zh: 逻辑空间控制 。 许多方法通过它的对数直接改变一个被冻结的模型的行为,包括无分解引导(Ho & Salimans, 2022),对比解码(Li等人, 2023),后热校准(Guo等人, 2017),以及水印,它偏向一个伪随机的符号对数子集来嵌入可探测信号(Kirchenbauer等人, 2023). 这些方法设计或适合某种特定的逻辑转换,以适应所期望的行为. 相比之下,logit PSV则使用任务不可知随机偏差,依靠选择和投票来利用由此产生的产出多样性.

blocks.en:
Perturbations in weight space. Previous work has revealed substantial structure in the local geometry of neural-network parameters, including mode connectivity ( Garipov et al., 2018 ) , model averaging ( Izmailov et al., 2018 ; Wortsman et al., 2022 ) , and low-dimensional adaptation ( Li et al., 2018 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) . Random weight perturbations are also central to evolution strategies and zeroth-order optimization ( Salimans et al., 2017 ) . Our focus is different: rather than optimizing or merging perturbations, we ask which aspects of weight-space perturbation are actually necessary for the gains of PSV.
Additional related work is discussed in Appendix A .

体重空间的扰动 以前的工作揭示了神经网络参数的局部几何结构,包括模式连接(Garipov等人,2018年),模式平均(Izmailov等人,2018年;Wortsman等人,2022年),以及低维适应(Li等人,2018年;Hu等人,2022年). 随机重量扰动也是演化策略和零顺序优化的核心(Salimans等人,2017年). 我们的重点不同:与其优化或合并扰动,不如问重力空间扰动的哪些方面对于PSV的增益实际上是必要的.

blocks.en: We use perturb-select-vote (PSV) to denote a general test-time adaptation template inspired by Neural Thickets, but not restricted to full-weight perturbations. The procedure is defined by three choices: a perturbation space, a selection set, and an aggregation rule. Neural Thickets ( Gan & Isola, 2026 ) correspond to the full-weight instance of PSV, where the perturbation space is the full parameter vector of the model, see top path of Figure 1 .

blocks.en: The central interpretation of Gan & Isola (2026) is that these gains reveal local task experts near the pretrained weights. This interpretation rests on three main claims. First, a density claim: as model size increases, a larger fraction of nearby perturbations improves task performance. Second, a specialist claim: perturbations that improve one task tend to hurt others, suggesting task-specific specialization. Third, a competitiveness claim: RandOpt with K = 50 K=50 mostly matches or outperforms task-adaptation methods, including reinforcement-learning methods such as PPO ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) and GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , while a test-time majority-vote baseline is reported as weaker. Together, these claims frame the gains as a property of the local weight neighborhood. In the following sections, we keep the PSV procedure fixed and vary only the perturbation space, asking whether the observed gains require perturbing the full weight vector.
blocks.zh: 中央对Gan & Isola(2026年)的解释是,这些成果揭示了当地任务专家靠近预先训练的重量. 这一解释基于三个主要主张。 首先,密度主张:随着模型大小的增大,附近扰动的更大部分会改善任务性能. 第二,专家主张:改进一项任务的扰动往往会伤害其他任务,表明任务特有的专业化。 第三,竞争性索赔:K=50K=50的RandOpt大多匹配或超过任务调整方法,包括强化学习方法,如PPO(Schulman等人,2017年)和GRPO(Shao等人,2024年),而测试时间多数投票基线则报告为较弱。 这些索赔加在一起,将收益定为当地体重区的财产。 在以下各节中,我们保持PSV程序的固定,只改变扰动空间,询问观察到的增益是否需要扰动全重矢量.

blocks.en: 4 Weight Perturbations Are Not Necessary
blocks.zh: 4 重量干扰是不必要的

blocks.en: We now investigate the mechanism underlying PSV. We progressively simplify the perturbation mechanism, first localizing it within the network and then moving it entirely to the output logits. This output-space view connects PSV to standard sampling, selection, and voting methods, allows us to isolate the source of its gains, and finally explains why internal perturbations behave similarly through the logit perturbations they induce.
blocks.zh: 我们现在调查PSV背后的机制. 我们逐渐简化扰动机制,先将其定位在网络内,然后完全移到输出日志上. 这种输出-空间视图将PSV与标准采样,选择和投票方法连接起来,使我们能够隔离其收益的来源,最后解释了为什么内部扰动通过它们诱导的对数扰动来进行类似的行为.

blocks.en: 4.1 Local Weight Perturbations Suffice
blocks.zh: 4.1 当地重量

blocks.en: Full-weight PSV, as used in Neural Thickets, perturbs every parameter of the model. However, such exhaustive perturbations are not necessary. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct for Countdown with K = 50 K=50 , the greedy base model reaches 66.6 % 66.6\% and full-weight PSV reaches 90.8 % 90.8\% . As shown in Figure 2 , perturbing only a single decoder block already recovers much of this gain. Every block substantially improves over the base model, with later blocks being the most effective. Thus, the gain does not require a coordinated perturbation of the full network.
blocks.zh: 完全重量的PSV,如神经纹理中使用的,扰动模型的每个参数. 然而,这种详尽无遗的干扰是不必要的。 在OLMo-3-7B-指令以K=50K=50进行倒计时时时,贪婪的基模达到66.6%66.6\%,全重PSV达到90.8%90.8\%. 如图2所示,只扰动一个单一的解码器块就已经回收了这一收益的大部分. 每个区块都大大改善了基建模型,后期区块最为有效. 因此,收益并不要求对整个网络进行协调一致的干扰。

blocks.en: The same holds within a transformer block. We perturb a single component of the first decoder block while keeping all remaining parameters frozen. Every component recovers most of the full-weight gain (Figure 3 ). Components that write directly into the residual stream recover the full gain, while the value and feed-forward input projections recover 96 96 – 99 % 99\% . The query/key path, which acts indirectly through the attention softmax, recovers 85 85 – 89 % 89\% . Qwen2.5 exhibits the same pattern from 0.5B to 3B (Appendix C ). Thus, most of the PSV gain can arise from highly localized perturbations.

blocks.en: The preceding results raise a more direct question: are weight perturbations needed at all? We test this by moving the perturbation entirely to the output space. The model remains fully frozen, and only its output logits are perturbed during decoding. This yields a simpler PSV variant and connects PSV directly to standard sampling and ensembling methods.

On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, it raises MATH-500 from 63.3 % 63.3\% to 81.3 % 81.3\% , compared with 74.7 % 74.7\% for full-weight PSV at the same N N and K K . It also improves GSM8K from 87.5 % 87.5\% to 91.9 % 91.9\% . On USPTO it reaches 42.7 % 42.7\% against 39.4 % 39.4\% , but by predicting the majority reaction class more often: its balanced accuracy is lower ( 26.7 % 26.7\% against 29.7 % 29.7\% ). Across the 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, and 7B models, logit PSV closely tracks the full-weight method: it is more accurate on 13 13 of the 15 15 reasoning cells and within 0.6 0.6 points on the other two, while on MBPP, ROCStories, and USPTO it is usually below it (Table 5 ). At a matched budget of N = 5000 N{=}5000 under the original protocol, the two methods are statistically indistinguishable on 22 22 of 28 28 model–task pairs; logit PSV is significantly better on three reasoning pairs and significantly worse on three others, and never worse on a reasoning task (Appendix C.1 ). blocks.en: The key difference between logit PSV and ordinary output sampling is that each sampled bias defines a persistent ensemble member. Its validation reward therefore measures how well the same token-preference shift performs across many examples from the target task. PSV ranks the sampled biases by this reward, retains the top K K , and reuses those same biases on unseen test inputs.
blocks.zh: logit PSV与普通输出采样的关键区别在于,每个采样偏差都定义了持久的共聚体成员. 因此,它的验证奖励衡量了同一同义偏好转变在从目标任务中的许多例子中的表现。 PSV通过这一奖励对抽样的偏差进行排序,保留最高的K K,并将同样的偏差重新用于未见的测试输入。

blocks.en: This differs from best-of- N N decoding ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , where multiple candidate answers are generated independently for each test input and a verifier or reward model selects among them at test time. PSV instead performs selection once on a validation set and requires no test-time verifier. It also differs from temperature sampling, whose randomness is resampled independently at each decoding step and for each input; individual random draws therefore do not define reusable members whose validation performance can be transferred to future examples (see Proposition 2 ). Temperature-tuned majority voting (TT-MV), the test-time baseline of Gan & Isola (2026) built on self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , shares the output diversity and voting stages of logit PSV, but omits this validation-based selection of persistent perturbations.

blocks.en: 4.4 Disentangling the Source of PSV Gains
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 消除 PSV 收益的来源

blocks.en: We next ask which parts of PSV are necessary. To isolate the effect of output diversity and voting without validation-based selection, we compare against temperature-tuned majority voting (TT-MV). This baseline majority-votes over samples of the base model at temperature T T . We fix T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 for every task and model instead of choosing it on the test set; choosing it on the test set would raise TT-MV by at most 4.0 4.0 points on OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, but by up to 16.9 16.9 points on weaker models.

TT-MV removes the validation-selection step, so its failures identify regimes where diversity and voting alone are insufficient. On weaker base models, sampling can produce diverse outputs without assigning enough probability mass to correct ones. Figure 5 shows such a case on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct for USPTO: TT-MV remains at or below 6.9 % 6.9\% for all temperatures, while full-weight PSV reaches 24.9 % 24.9\% . This gain largely reflects improved label consistency rather than better task performance: PSV predicts the majority reaction class on 76 % 76\% of test examples and still underperforms the 31.9 % 31.9\% majority-class baseline. A cleaner example is Countdown with the same model, where TT-MV peaks at 34.3 % 34.3\% ( T = 0.12 T{=}0.12 ), below full-weight PSV at 37.4 % 37.4\% . This gap does not require a weight-space expert explanation. It shows that validation-based selection can be important when the base sampler is too unreliable for majority voting alone.
Overall, PSV gains arise from candidate diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. Strong models may benefit from sampling and voting alone, whereas weaker models also benefit from selection.

总体而言,PSV收益来自候选人的多样性、基于验证的甄选和投票。 单靠取样和投票可能有利于强有力的模型,而较弱的模型也有利于选择。

blocks.en: We provide a linearized view of PSV that connects full-weight perturbations to output-space perturbations. In this view, a weight perturbation matters through its induced first-order change in the logits, and logit PSV directly injects a simpler version of the same output diversity.
blocks.zh: 我们提供一个线性化的PSV视图,将全重扰动与输出-空间扰动连接起来. 在这种观点下,通过在对数中诱发的第一顺序变化,重量扰动关系重大,而logit PSV直接注入同一个输出多样性的更简单的版本.

For a perturbed model 𝜽 + σ ​ ϵ \bm{\theta}+\sigma\bm{\epsilon} , a first-order expansion gives ℓ 𝜽 + σ ​ ϵ ​ ( x ) ≈ ℓ 𝜽 ​ ( x ) + σ ​ 𝐉 ​ ( x ) ​ ϵ , 𝐉 ⁡ ( x ) = ∂ ℓ 𝜽 ​ ( x ) ∂ 𝜽 . \displaystyle\bm{\ell}_{\bm{\theta}+\sigma\bm{\epsilon}}\left(x\right)\approx\bm{\ell}_{\bm{\theta}}\left(x\right)+\sigma\mathbf{J}\left(x\right)\bm{\epsilon},\qquad\mathbf{J}\left(x\right)=\frac{\partial\bm{\ell}_{\bm{\theta}}\left(x\right)}{\partial\bm{\theta}}~. (7) Thus, regardless of where the perturbation is applied in the network, its leading-order effect is a structured perturbation of the logits. This explains why perturbing even a small subset of the weights can recover most of the effect of perturbing the full network (Figure 3 ): any internal perturbation is propagated through the residual stream to the logits, while its location mainly determines the magnitude and structure of the resulting logit perturbation. In particular, the attention softmax attenuates perturbations along the query/key path without eliminating them (Appendix B.5 ). Logit PSV can therefore be viewed as a cheaper output-space surrogate: it injects diversity directly at the logits, rather than producing it indirectly through a forward pass with perturbed weights.

blocks.en: 5 Extending PSV to Vision
blocks.zh: 5 将 PSV 扩展至愿景

blocks.en:
Vision differs from language in two key ways that matter for our analysis. First, LLMs reuse the same token-prediction head learned during pretraining across downstream tasks.
In contrast, vision foundation models are typically adapted by fitting a new linear probe on the target-task training set. The vision probe can therefore absorb domain-specific calibration effects that remain exposed in the LLM output distribution. Second, language models generate autoregressive trajectories, so voting over sampled outputs can benefit from self-consistency ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . A vision classifier instead produces a single class prediction per image, with no analogous trajectory-level diversity.
blocks.zh:
愿景与语言不同,有两种关键方式对我们的分析至关重要。 首先,LLMS重复使用在跨下游任务前期训练期间学到的相同符号预测头.
与此相反,理想基础模型通常通过在目标任务培训中安装一个新的线性探测器来加以调整。 因此,视觉探测器可以吸收在LLM输出分布中仍然暴露的针对域的校准效应. 其次,语言模型产生自旋性轨迹,因此对抽样产出的投票可以得益于自我一致性(Wang等人,2023年). 相反,一个视觉分类器对每个图像进行单一的类预测,没有类似的轨迹级别多样性。

blocks.en: Based on these differences, we transpose the Neural Thickets hypothesis to vision by changing the notion of specialization. We restrict our analysis to classification, but vary the image domains. We therefore define a vision domain expert as a perturbed backbone whose frozen representations support a better linear probe on a given target domain. If such experts exist in the local weight neighborhood, perturbing the backbone and refitting the probe should improve transfer. Conversely, if the gains arise mainly from output-space effects, perturbing only the class logits should be sufficient. We test these alternatives with a self-supervised DINOv3 backbone ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , comparing full-weight PSV, patch-embedding PSV, and logit PSV.
blocks.zh: 基于这些差异,我们通过改变专业化的概念,将神经细胞假说转换为视觉. 我们的分析仅限于分类,但改变图像域。 因此,我们把视域专家定义为一个扰动的骨干,其冻结的表示支持对某一目标域进行更好的线性探测。 如果这些专家在当地体重区存在,干扰骨干和重新配置探测器应可改善转移。 相反,如果收益主要来自产出-空间效应,则只干扰类对数就足够了。 我们用自控的DINOv3主干线(Siméoni等人,2025年)测试这些替代品,比较全重PSV,补丁嵌入PSV,以及登录PSV.

Table 3 reports gains over the base linear probe. We consider two datasets exhibiting strong train-to-test distribution shifts for the probe: FMoW ( Christie et al., 2018 ) , evaluated with worst-region accuracy, and Waterbirds ( Sagawa et al., 2020 ) , evaluated with worst-group accuracy. We additionally include balanced ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) as a control setting without such a shift.
The two weight-space variants, full-weight and patch PSV, have little effect, improving worst-group accuracy by at most one point even for the 6.7 6.7 B backbone. By contrast, logit PSV improves worst-group accuracy by 5 5 - 6 6 points while leaving both backbone and probe unchanged. Closed-form recalibration recovers most of this gain on FMoW; on the binary Waterbirds task, it matches logit PSV by effectively selecting an improved decision threshold. On balanced ImageNet, none of the methods provides a substantial gain.

两个重量空间变体,即全重和补丁PSV,效果甚微,甚至对6.7 B骨干而言,在最多一个点上提高了最差组的精度. 相比之下,logit PSV将最差组的精度提高了5 5 - 6 6分,同时使主干线和探测器都保持不变. 闭式重排在FMOW上回收了大部分的这种收益;在二进制水鸟任务上,它通过有效选择改进的决定阈值来匹配登录PSV. 在平衡的ImageNet上,没有一种方法能带来巨大的收益.

blocks.en: These results suggest that the vision gains are primarily a recalibration effect. Logit PSV improves worst-group performance by roughly 5 5 to 6 6 points on FMoW and Waterbirds, both of which exhibit substantial train-to-test shifts, but provides essentially no gain on balanced ImageNet, where train and evaluation distributions are aligned. The closed-form correction reinforces this interpretation, recovering most of the logit-PSV gain on the shifted datasets by directly recalibrating the class marginal, while again yielding no meaningful improvement on ImageNet.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,愿景的提高主要是调整效果。 Logit PSV在FMOW和Waterbirds上提高了大约5,5至6个最差组的性能,两者都表现出大量的列车到测试班次,但基本上对平衡的ImageNet没有好处,因为其中的列车和评价分布一致. 闭式校正强化了这种解释,通过直接校正类边际,恢复了变换数据集的大部分登录-PSV增益,同时再次在ImageNet上没有产生有意义的改进.

blocks.en: Furthermore, if random backbone perturbations revealed domain-specialized representations, refitting a probe on them should improve target-domain performance. We do not observe this, even at the largest scale considered, 6.7 6.7 B parameters. Instead, gains appear only when the output distribution is modified, suggesting that vision PSV is better explained by recalibration under distribution shift than by nearby domain experts in weight space.
blocks.zh: 此外,如果随机的骨干干扰显示域内专门化的表示,重新对其进行探测应可提高目标域的性能。 我们没有观察到这一点,即使在考虑的最大尺度,6.7 6.7 B参数。 相反,收益只在输出分布被修改时才会出现,这表明比起附近在重量空间的域专家来说,在分配转变下重新校准PSV更能解释视觉PSV.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The gains of Neural Thickets do not require perturbing the full model: comparable improvements arise from perturbing a single decoder block or only the logits of a frozen model. This supports interpreting Neural Thickets through perturb-select-vote, connecting them to perturb-and-MAP sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. In vision, gains under domain shift likewise arise primarily at the classifier output. These findings do not rule out useful local structure in weight space, but show that it is not required for the gains studied here.
blocks.zh: 神经切除器的增益不需要扰动完整的模型:可比的改进来自扰动单个解码器块或仅冷冻模型的对数. 这支持通过ururb-select-vote来解释神经切片,将其连接到ururb-和-MAP的采样,自相容性,以及核查器-制导的选择. 在愿景中,域转移下的收益同样主要来自分类器产出。 这些调查结果不排除在重量空间中有用的局部结构,但表明在此研究的增益并不需要.

blocks.en: Our language experiments stop at 7B parameters; larger models may exhibit weight-space effects that logit perturbations fail to capture. PSV requires a labeled selection set and a way to compare generated answers for voting, limiting its applicability to open-ended generation. Our first-order analysis is valid only for sufficiently small σ \sigma . Finally, like full-weight PSV, logit PSV requires K K model evaluations per test input, increasing inference cost relative to a single prediction.
blocks.zh: 我们的语言实验以7B参数止步;更大的模型可能表现出重空效应,而登录扰动无法捕捉到. PSV要求有标签的选集和一种比较生成的投票答案的方法,将它的适用性限制在不限成员名额的一代. 我们的第一排分析只对足够小的\\sigma有效。 最后,与全重的PSV一样,logit PSV要求每一次测试输入都要进行K K模型评价,相对于一个单一的预测,推论成本会增加.

blocks.en: This work analyzes and simplifies inference-time adaptation methods for pretrained models. All experiments use publicly available models and datasets; no new data were collected and no human subjects were involved. Logit PSV only reweights the outputs of a frozen model, so it inherits the biases and failure modes of the underlying model, and, like other training-free adaptation methods, it could in principle be used to steer a model toward undesirable behavior. We evaluate it only on standard reasoning, chemistry, and image recognition benchmarks, and we do not expect it to introduce risks beyond those of the pretrained models it builds on.

blocks.en: Appendix A Extended Related work
blocks.zh: 附录A 扩大的相关工作

blocks.en: Test-time sampling and answer selection. A long line of work improves fixed models at inference by sampling multiple outputs and aggregating or selecting them. Self-consistency returns the majority answer over diverse reasoning paths ( Wang et al., 2023 ) ; repeated sampling improves coverage as the sample count grows ( Brown et al., 2024 ) , and allocating inference compute effectively can match much larger models ( Snell et al., 2025 ) . When a verifier or reward model is available, best-of- N N selects the highest-scoring candidate ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , while minimum Bayes risk decoding aggregates over the sampled distribution ( Eikema & Aziz, 2020 ) . Recent work further studies the coverage, optimality, and reward-model dependence of best-of- N N and related test-time scaling procedures ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Sriraman & Block, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Perturb-and-MAP provides the classical link between perturbation and sampling: adding Gumbel noise to logits and taking the arg-max yields exact categorical sampling ( Papandreou & Yuille, 2011 ; Maddison et al., 2017 ; Jang et al., 2017 ) , closely related to temperature and nucleus sampling ( Holtzman et al., 2020 ) . We place Neural Thickets ( Gan & Isola, 2026 ) in this broader family: perturbations generate diversity, validation-based selection favors high-reward members, and voting aggregates their predictions.
blocks.zh: 测试时间采样和答案选择。 长期工作通过取样多种产出并汇总或选择这些产出,改进了推断的固定模型。 自我一致性在不同的推理路径上返回多数答案(Wang等人,2023年);随着样本数的增加(Brown等人,2024年),重复采样提高了覆盖范围(Brown等人,2024年),并且有效分配推论计算可以匹配更大的模型(Snell等人,2025年)。 当有一个验证或奖励模式可用时,最佳N选择得分最高的候选人(Cobbe等人,2021年),而Bayes最小的风险解码总量则超过抽样分布(Eikema & Aziz,2020年). 最近的工作进一步研究了最佳NN和相关测试时间缩放程序的覆盖面、最佳性和奖励模式依赖性(Huang等人,2025年;Sriraman & Block,2026年;Li等人,2026年)。 Perturb-and-MAP提供了扰动和采样之间的经典联系:将Gumbel噪声添加到对数中,并采用arg-max产生精确的绝对抽样(Papandreou & Yuille,2011年;Maddison等人,2017年;Jang等人,2017年),与温度和核取样密切相关(Holtzman等人,2020年)。 我们把神经细胞(Gan & Isola, 2026年)放在这个更广泛的家族中:扰动产生多样性,基于验证的选择偏好高回报的成员,并投票汇总他们的预测.

blocks.en: Logit-space control. A growing body of work modifies model behavior directly in logit space while keeping the underlying predictor fixed. This includes watermarking, which biases selected token logits to embed a detectable signal ( Kirchenbauer et al., 2023 ) , classifier-free guidance ( Ho & Salimans, 2022 ; Sanchez et al., 2024 ) , contrastive decoding ( Li et al., 2023 ) , decoding-time experts ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , and proxy-tuning ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Post-hoc calibration adjusts the outputs of a fixed model with a temperature ( Guo et al., 2017 ) or with per-class corrections for new class priors ( Saerens et al., 2002 ) , long-tailed classes ( Menon et al., 2021 ) , or the answer biases of language models ( Zhao et al., 2021 ) . Class-level logit perturbations have also been learned for single- and multi-label classification ( Li et al., 2024 ) , sample-wise ones against spurious correlations ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and corpus-specific token scores steer frozen language models ( An et al., 2026 ) . These methods design or fit the logit modification for a specific task. In contrast, logit PSV samples task-agnostic random biases.
blocks.zh: 逻辑空间控制 。 不断增长的工作体直接在登录空间修改模型行为,同时保持基础预测器的固定. 这包括水标记,它偏差了选定的符号对数,以嵌入可探测信号(Kirchenbauer等人,2023年),无分类指导(Ho & Salimans,2022年;Sanchez等人,2024年),对比解码(Li等人,2023年),解码时间专家 (刘等,2021年),和代调(刘等,2024年). 校准后调整固定型号的输出,温度(郭等人,2017年)或新类前科的每级校正(Saerens等人,2002年),长尾类(Menon等人,2021年),或语言模型的答案偏差(赵等人,2021年). 在单一和多标签分类(Li等人,2024年)方面,也学到了类级登录扰动(Zhou等人,2025年),抽样对照虚假的关联性(An等人,2026年),以及实体特定符号分数指导冷冻语言模型(An等人,2026年)。 这些方法为具体任务设计或符合对登录的修改。 相比之下,logit PSV对任务不可知的随机偏差进行抽样.

blocks.en: Merging and connectivity in weight space. A substantial literature studies when different solutions can be combined in weight space. Stochastic weight averaging averages checkpoints along a training trajectory to improve generalization ( Izmailov et al., 2018 ) , while model soups average independently fine-tuned models without sacrificing accuracy ( Wortsman et al., 2022 ) . Related work composes task vectors ( Ilharco et al., 2023 ) or explicitly merges multiple specialists ( Matena & Raffel, 2022 ; Yadav et al., 2023 ) . These observations are closely connected to mode connectivity ( Garipov et al., 2018 ) , linear connectivity after accounting for permutation symmetries ( Frankle et al., 2020 ; Ainsworth et al., 2023 ) , and shared low-loss basins across tasks ( Mirzadeh et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 在重量空间进行合并和连接。 当不同的溶液在重量空间中可以结合时,进行实质性的文献研究. Stochastic weights平均指沿训练轨迹设置的检查站,以提高通俗性(Izmailov等人,2018年),而模型汤平均独立微调模型,而不牺牲准确性(Wortsman等人,2022年)。 相关工作组成任务矢量(Ilharco等人,2023年)或明确合并多个专家(Matena & Raffel,2022年;Yadav等人,2023年). 这些观测结果与模式互联互通(Garipov等人,2018年)紧密相连,线性互联互通核算了穿梭对称(Frankle等人,2020年;Ainsworth等人,2023年),跨任务共享低损失盆地(Mirzadeh等人,2021年).

blocks.en: Low-dimensional structure and random perturbations. A substantial literature suggests that useful adaptation directions can occupy low-dimensional subspaces. Objective landscapes can have low intrinsic dimension ( Li et al., 2018 ) , language-model fine-tuning often lies in low-dimensional subspaces ( Aghajanyan et al., 2021 ) , and low-rank adapters can efficiently specialize large models ( Hu et al., 2022 ) . Relatedly, evolution strategies and zeroth-order methods optimize models by evaluating random weight perturbations ( Salimans et al., 2017 ; Malladi et al., 2023 ) . Unlike Neural Thickets, however, these methods explicitly optimize the perturbations rather than selecting among unstructured random draws. Concurrent work similarly explores more structured searches of the local weight neighborhood, either by consolidating rewarded perturbations ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) or by using Bayesian optimization to identify strong single experts with fewer evaluations ( Cendra et al., 2026 ) . These results are complementary to ours: structured weight-space search may be useful even if the gains of random PSV do not require a weight-space explanation.
blocks.zh: 低维结构与随机扰动. 大量文献表明,有用的适应方向可以占据低维子空间. 客观景观可以有低的内在维度(Li等人,2018年),语言模型的微调往往位于低维子空间(Aghajanyan等人,2021年),低级适配器可以高效地专门使用大型模型(Hu等人,2022年). 与此相关,演化策略和零序方法通过随机加权扰动评价优化模型(Salimans等人,2017年;Malladi等人,2023年). 然而,与神经毛不同,这些方法明确优化了扰动,而不是在无结构的随机抽取中选择. 同时期工作同样通过整合奖励性扰动(张等人,2026年)或利用巴耶斯优化确定评价较少的强大单一专家(Cendra等人,2026年),探索对当地体重街区进行更有条理的搜索. 这些结果对我们来说是互补的:结构化的权重空间搜索可能有用,即使随机PSV的增益不需要权重空间解释.

blocks.en: We test the “dense, connected neighborhood” picture directly on the OLMo-3-7B Countdown thicket. Clustering: the top- 50 50 perturbation directions have a mean pairwise cosine of 6 × 10 − 5 6{\times}10^{-5} (standard deviation 4.6 × 10 − 3 4.6{\times}10^{-3} ), nearly identical to random perturbation pairs ( 1 × 10 − 5 1{\times}10^{-5} , standard deviation 4.5 × 10 − 3 4.5{\times}10^{-3} ); the selected directions show no detectable directional clustering by this statistic. Connectivity: averaging two top members with norm preserved and scoring on 200 200 held-out test items gives a midpoint accuracy of 69.8 % 69.8\% against 69.7 % 69.7\% at the endpoints; two random perturbations give 69.3 % 69.3\% against 69.4 % 69.4\% (base 67.7 % 67.7\% , 20 20 pairs each). The straight path between selected members shows no barrier, so connectivity does not separate them from random perturbations; on held-out items the selected members are barely better than random ones ( 69.7 % 69.7\% against 69.4 % 69.4\% ). Generalization: the best single member improves the selection set by 11 11 points but the held-out test set by only 2.4 2.4 . Together with the soup collapse (Table 1 ), the clustering and generalization results provide little support for interpreting the selected members as a coherent dense weight-space basin. They are instead consistent with selection over dispersed perturbations followed by output-space voting.

blocks.en: We report the complete ensemble-size sweep behind the output-space claims, comparing the three PSV variants head to head at every scale and task. Full-weight PSV perturbs all model weights, logit PSV adds a persistent Gaussian bias to the output logits, and TT-MV performs temperature sampling at T = 0.7 T{=}0.7 followed by plurality voting, without reward-based selection. Each is swept over K ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , 8 , 16 , 32 , 64 , 128 } K\in\{1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128\} on four model scales (0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B) and three tasks (Countdown, GSM8K, MATH-500). Figure 9 shows raw majority-vote accuracy against the greedy base, and Figure 10 the same runs as gain over base. Across these sweeps, accuracy generally increases with K K , with larger gains at larger model scales. Logit PSV closely tracks or exceeds full-weight PSV on the reasoning tasks, while TT-MV falls behind primarily in the weak-model regime where reward-based selection is most useful (e.g. 0.5B and 1.5B Countdown).

blocks.en: D.2 Are Weight and Logit Perturbations Complementary?
blocks.zh: D.2 重量和逻辑干扰是否互为补充?

blocks.en: If weight and logit perturbations provided complementary sources of useful variation, combining them could improve over either intervention alone. We test this directly by composing the two perturbations. For each model and task, we summarize each method by its peak accuracy over the evaluated K K values and compare four ensembles: full-weight PSV alone, logit PSV alone, full-weight PSV applied on top of logit PSV ( weight ∘ \circ logit ), and, as a control, a second logit perturbation composed with the first using a smaller noise range ( logit ∘ \circ logit ). The control tests whether any benefit from combining weight and logit perturbations exceeds that obtained by simply composing two output-space perturbations.
blocks.zh: 如果重量和记录扰动提供了有用的变化的补充来源,将它们结合起来,就可以单靠任何一种干预来改进。 我们直接通过编织两个扰动来测试。 对于每个模型和任务,我们用其峰值精确度比评价的K K 值来总结每个方法,并比较四个共性:全重的PSV单数,全数的PSV单数,在logit PSV(重量=\circ logit)之上应用的全重的PSV(重量=\\circ logit),以及作为控制,由第一个使用较小噪声范围(logit=\circ logit)构成的第二个对数扰动. 控制测试结合重量和对数扰动的任何好处是否超过简单地组合两个输出-空间扰动所获得的好处。

blocks.en: Figure 11 reports the corresponding peak gains over base, and Figure 12 compares the combined method with the better single intervention and with the logit-on-logit control. On nine of twelve model–task pairs, the combined method matches or trails the better single intervention, and it shows no systematic advantage over the logit-on-logit control. Only 7B MATH-500 improves over both comparisons, by 1.0 1.0 point over the better single intervention and 0.3 0.3 points over the control ( 3 3 and 1 1 of its 300 300 test items). We therefore find little evidence that weight and logit perturbations provide complementary gains, consistent with the view that they largely act through the same output-space mechanism.
blocks.zh: 图11报告了相应的峰值收益高于基数,图12将合并方法与更好的单一干预和登录登录控制进行比较。 在12个模型任务对中的9个上,组合方法匹配或跟踪了更好的单一干预,这表明在登录登录控制上没有系统性优势. 只有7B MATH-500比这两个比较都有所改善,比更好的单一干预多1.0分,比控制多0.3分(在其300个测试项目中的3个3个和1个)。 因此,我们发现没有多少证据表明重量和记录扰动提供了补充性收益,这与它们主要通过相同的产出-空间机制行事的观点是一致的。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Accuracy gains from individual and stacked perturbation mechanisms. Peak gain over greedy decoding across ensemble sizes K K , comparing full-weight PSV, logit PSV, their combination, and a same-mechanism control that stacks two logit biases with a smaller noise range. The symbol “ ∘ \circ ” denotes successive application of two perturbations. Combining weight and logit perturbations rarely improves upon the stronger individual method or the logit-only control, except on 7B MATH-500.
blocks.zh: 图11:个人和堆积扰动机制的准确性收益。 峰值增益过贪婪的解码,跨越综艺的大小KK,比较了全重PSV,logit PSV,它们的组合,以及同机控制,将两个logit偏差叠加到一个较小的噪声范围. 符号“\\circ ”表示连续适用两次扰动。 除7B MATH-500型外,结合重量和对数扰动很少会改进更强的个别方法或仅限对数的控制.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Peak accuracy of stacked perturbations versus individual methods and a logit-only control. Full-weight PSV stacked on logit PSV is compared against (a) the stronger individual method and (b) the same-mechanism control, which stacks two logit biases. The dashed diagonal indicates equal accuracy. Most points lie on or below it. Above it are 3B and 7B MATH-500 ( + 1.3 +1.3 , + 1.0 +1.0 ) and 7B GSM8K ( + 0.2 +0.2 ) in (a), and 7B Countdown ( + 0.9 +0.9 ), 7B MATH-500 ( + 0.3 +0.3 ), and 3B Countdown ( + 0.2 +0.2 ) in (b); only 7B MATH-500 is above it in both.
blocks.zh: 图12:堆叠扰动的峰值精度与个别方法的对比,以及仅限登录的控制. 在logit PSV上堆叠的全重PSV与(a) 更强的单个方法和(b) 同机控制相比,它堆叠了两个logit偏差. 破损的对角表示同样准确。 多数观点都位于或低于它。 上面是(a)中的3B和7B MATH-500(+1.3+1.3,+1.0+1.0)和7B GSM8K(+0.2+0.2),以及(b)中的7B 倒计时(+0.9+0.9),7B MATH-500(+0.3+0.3)和3B 倒计时(+0.2+0.2);两者中只有7B MATH-500以上.
